#Create binary

tracks <- leopardseal_all_tracks_mp

tracks$g_bin <- ifelse(tracks$g > 0.5, 1, 0)

# Save it
saveRDS(tracks, "tracks.rds")

# Later reload it
```{r}
tracks <- readRDS("tracks.rds")
```

Re do with sims
```{r}

library(dplyr)

ls <- leopardseal_all_tracks_mp

tracks_real <- tracks %>%
  filter(presence != 0)

tracks_sim <- tracks %>%
  filter(presence != 1)

tracks_sim$id  <- as.character(tracks_sim$id)
real_filter$id <- as.character(real_filter$id)


library(sf)
library(dplyr)

real_filter_clean <- real_filter %>%
  select(-geometry, -`...18`) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = st_crs(tracks_sim), remove = FALSE)

real_filter_clean$id <- as.character(real_filter_clean$id)
tracks_vars_behav <- bind_rows(tracks_sim, real_filter_clean)


```

binary
```{r}

tracks_vars_behav$g_bin <- ifelse(tracks_vars_behav$g > 0.5, 1, 0)

saveRDS(tracks_vars_behav, "tracks_vars_behav.rds")

```
